text:
Anika: starting a quick kernel-fingerprint sweep across L40S / H100 / A100. seq lens: [32, 128, 512, 1024, 2048], batch sizes: [1,4,8,16]. using fused-paged-flash variant + our runtime heuristics. saw a weird throughput drop on L40S at seq=512 batch=8. KV-cache miss rate jumped. running on staging-rack-7. anyone seen this pattern before?

Jon: can you paste the numbers? throughput and p99s?

Anika: sure, small paste:
```
GPU    seq  batch  tps_infer  p99_ms  kv_miss_pct
L40S   128  8      980        21.3    4.2
L40S   512  8      520        48.7    23.9  <-- regression
H100   512  8      1400       19.1    2.1
A100   512  8      870        27.5    3.9
```

Anika: note: H100/A100 stable, only L40S shows big drop. logs show prefetch evictions and a KV cache spill loop.

Priya: hmm, L40S has smaller L2 and different SM scheduling — could be kernel tiling picked the wrong blocksize. did kernel selector fallback to paged variant?

Anika: runtime selected `flash_fused_paged_v2` for that point. kernel logs: `selector: chosen=flash_fused_paged_v2 reason=latency_estimate`. but we see continuous evictions:
```
[evictor] loop: insert=2048KB, evicted=2300KB, spill=true
[kv] miss_rate=0.239 queue_len=12
```

Kevin: can you try forcing the non-paged fused flash path? maybe the paged path thrashes due to the L40S memory band. try env override: `REDWOOD_KERNEL_FORCE=flash_fused_nopage` and run same sweep.

Anika: doing that now. quick command I used: `./bench_runner --model gpt-mini --seq 512 --batch 8 --gpu L40S --variant fused-paged-flash`

perf-bot: CI-run 2267891240 finished (quick-smoke). summary: 24 experiments, 3 failures (timeouts), avg runtime 2m12s. link: https://ci.redwood/2267891240

Oli: another angle — check batching heuristic. L40S may benefit from smaller micro-batches to avoid KV hotspots. try batch 4 at seq 512 and enable `CONT_BATCHING=0` to force single-request handling.

Anika: ran forced non-paged path + batch4 + CONT_BATCHING=0. results:
```
L40S seq=512 batch=4 forced=flash_fused_nopage tps=970 p99=23.4 kv_miss=3.5
L40S seq=512 batch=8 forced=flash_fused_nopage tps=880 p99=28.1 kv_miss=5.6
```

Anika: so non-paged helps a lot. looks like selector heuristic incorrectly favored paged to save memory but caused eviction churn on L40S.

Priya: sounds like we need a GPU-profiled fingerprint in the selector: if GPU.family == L40S and seq>=256 and batch>=8 prefer nopage. also update hysteresis to avoid flip-flop during rampups.

Kevin: agree. quick patch: add rule in kernel_selector: `if gpu_model contains "L40S" and seq >= 256 and batch >= 8 -> prefer=flash_fused_nopage weight=+8`. can we add a microbenchmark to cover seq 256-1024 batch 4-16 to validate?

Anika: will run overnight sweep and attach perf plots. adding ticket: PERF-1428 to formalize change + add microbench. @Oli can you review selector rule?

Oli: will take a look tomorrow. also let's add a KV-cache telemetry flag so we can correlate evictions to selector choices in prod. :+1:

Anika: thanks all — next steps: (1) overnight microbench across GPUs, (2) patch selector with L40S rule + unit tests, (3) add KV telemetry hook. I'll post results in this thread tomorrow. :rocket:
